title: Mothership Zeta Birth/Birthday Abduction Causality Forensics
scope: Separate four hypotheses often collapsed together: a visual/structural rhyme between the Lone Wanderer's birth and the Mothership Zeta examination; a shipped production trace explicitly referring to birthday material during the abduction examination; the in-world reason the Zetans abducted the Lone Wanderer; and the much stronger claim that the Zetans arranged the Lone Wanderer's birth in advance.

cg00_birth: Catherine enters cardiac arrest immediately after birth
player is removed from the immediate scene
zeta_examination: three alien examiners animate around the player
birth_scene_structural_rhyme.compressed: VOLUNTARY/HUMAN BIRTH THRESHOLD <-> COERCIVE/ALIEN EXAMINATION THRESHOLD

birthday_memory_design_trace.state_comment: incremented as happy place objects are swapped
birthday_memory_design_trace.developer_comment: This was the spot where the birthday stuff would pop up...
birthday_memory_design_trace.interpretation: The final shipped script retains a direct production trace that birthday/happy-place material was intended to appear during the coercive alien examination.
birthday_memory_design_trace.critical_boundary: BIRTHDAY != BIRTH. The surviving comment does not itself identify CG00 childbirth assets and does not prove that the Zetans canonically access the protagonist's memories.
birthday_memory_design_trace.likely_reference: The player's childhood/birthday material is a plausible target, especially the tenth-birthday quest Growing Up Fast (CG02), but the exact removed objects/assets are not established by the surviving line alone.

alien_motive.confirmed_about_player: The Lone Wanderer is proximity-triggered, abducted, stripped, immobilized and subjected to the examination/torture-device sequence.
general_program_evidence: Mothership Zeta contains captives collected from widely separated historical periods.
Alien captive recordings show interrogation, recording, cryogenic storage and severe physical experimentation.
A captive describes the recording process as resembling catalog entries for a collection.
Sally is repeatedly brought to the recording room; aliens react excitedly when she recognizes Giddyup Buttercup.
Large numbers of Giddyup Buttercups are stored in the research lab, supporting a collection/study context.
alien_motive.best_supported_model: COLLECTION / CATALOGING / CRYONIC PRESERVATION / BIOLOGICAL-AND-BEHAVIORAL EXPERIMENTATION

birth_staging_hypothesis.hypothesis: The Zetans intentionally arranged the conception/birth of the Lone Wanderer so the person would later become their target.
evidence_against: Project Purity journals document Catherine's pregnancy months before delivery as an ordinary known human pregnancy.
James and Catherine are established as the biological parents; the birth scene, James, Madison Li and later records converge on this history.
The shipped DLC abduction implementation checks player proximity to Recon Craft Theta/AlienRadioBeaconREF rather than an identity, lineage or birth predicate.
No reviewed shipped Mothership Zeta record binds the Zetans to Catherine, James, conception, pregnancy or the Jefferson Memorial birth in 2258.
birth_staging_hypothesis.claim_ceiling: Absence of a shipped alien-birth binding does not logically prove metaphysical impossibility; it means the staged-birth theory is not admitted by available shipped evidence.

sally_affect_probe_parallel.evidence: Alien captive log 21 has Sally recognize a Giddyup Buttercup and explicitly notice the aliens becoming excited about her response.
sally_affect_probe_parallel.parallel_to_abduction_happy: Both the Sally scene and DLC05MZ1AbductionHappy place a familiar/positive childhood signal inside a coercive alien research environment.
sally_affect_probe_parallel.overclaim_guard: Do not claim the Zetans canonically extract memories from the Lone Wanderer solely from this parallel.

causal_model.missing_edge: No shipped edge has been established from ZETANS to CONCEPTION/PREGNANCY/BIRTH.

engineering_extension.goal: Make the production birthday trace pass while forcing staged-birth and unique-preselection claims to fail unless proposition-bound evidence is introduced.

ru: В сцене похищения действительно остался след 'birthday stuff', но это не след управления самим рождением.
Сцену рождения и инопланетное обследование можно читать как два противоположных порога одного тела: появление в мире и насильственное изъятие из него.
Пришельцы явно используют людей как объекты исследования и коллекции; зачем им нужен именно Одинокий Путник как уникальная личность, игра не устанавливает.
Скрипт похищения реагирует на близость к Recon Craft Theta, а не на тайную метку происхождения.
Знакомый или счастливый детский сигнал внутри эксперимента не делает эксперимент добрым.
en: The abduction script genuinely retains a 'birthday stuff' production trace, but that is not evidence of control over the protagonist's birth.
Birth and alien examination form an interpretive pair of opposite bodily thresholds: entry into the world and coercive removal from it.
The Zetans clearly use humans as research/collection subjects; the game does not establish a unique person-specific reason for selecting the Lone Wanderer.
The shipped abduction script reacts to proximity to Recon Craft Theta, not to a hidden origin marker.
A familiar or happy childhood signal inside an experiment does not make the experiment benevolent.

verification_receipt.scope_boundary: The test model proves admission behavior for explicitly encoded shipped evidence atoms. It does not prove that no undiscovered cut/development asset exists, and it does not convert production comments into in-world alien memory technology.
